NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE IV: ROMANCE, COURTSHIP AND WEDDINGS (LCD-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Crushes and courting on Isola: wondering whether someone likes you back, flowers and love songs, first dates, serenades gone wrong, proposals, weddings big and small, how many children, breakups and starting over.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: On the wedding day, a storm floods the feast: move it inside, or celebrate in the rain.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) and (friend)'s wedding day has arrived, and so has a storm. The feast is laid out on the beach, the garlands are ready, and the rain is coming down so hard the drums are floating. The guests are huddled under palm leaves. What should the couple do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: Everyone crowds into the meeting hut with the food. It is hot, cramped and smells of wet garlands. The drummers play anyway. (subject) and (friend) make their promise squeezed between a grandmother and a goat. It is the most crowded wedding anyone remembers, and the warmest.

text_only.reason: food in the story (a meal, a catch, fruit); the village's stores do not change -- the draft's notes: everything but the marked effects is story only

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) takes (friend)'s hand and walks out into the rain. They make their promise standing in the downpour, soaked to the skin, laughing. The guests come out one by one and dance in the mud. The food is ruined. Nobody cares.
